device_smoke.hardening: device_smoke.sh now forces a DETERMINISTIC COLD START before install/launch (root-free mechanism: waydroid session stop -> session start -> wait for Android boot; the mechanism is echoed in the script output). Reason: install+launch alone does NOT reset the WebView, so the app could resume its last-visited page and the automated 'launch dashboard' capture caught the Watchlist instead of the Dashboard. After the hardening the launch capture and the after-restart capture are the same Dashboard and the pixel diff is 0.0.
device_smoke.prior_failures_explained: the two earlier reds were harness artifacts, never data loss: (1) the launch capture caught the Watchlist (app resumed its last page) vs the Dashboard; (2) both frames were the Dashboard but rendered at a different window scale after the container restart (~0.28 diff). The scale mode is tracked as issue #116.
device_smoke.durability_independent_evidence: the candidate added before a restart survived it (p3_watchlist_candidate_present.png was captured after the restart) - the app-private SQLite file is the persistence unit and it held.

notes: Release APK is signed with OUR local keystore (verified by apksigner cert digest); the debug keystore is not used.

E4 slimming removed only inert src/design; all runtime assets byte-identical.
The device pass is a genuine clean-data pass: fresh database, empty Watchlist/Alerts, badge 0, then a candidate added through the real UI and a process restart re-verified zero WARN.

device_smoke.sh now forces a deterministic cold start before install/launch, so the release gate is honest-green (durability ratio 0.0); issue #116 stays for the pixel-diff scale mode only, and no new issue was raised.
